descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S07 AI Check: the Mistral fallback's Ask AI answers never invent — 10 fixtures, 5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home (S08 merged here)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 The fallback model's output is held to the same rules as the primary's: never invent (3.4), and as an AI Check it runs on at least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home) passing at 9/ … (UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3)
  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral (UAT OAT-03 step 6; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; TFA-94422 AC 2)
  • U7 The output records which model produced it; each run records which AI ran each step (note model, speech-to-text engine, pre-round model, photo model, Ask AI model) (UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94422 AC 6; TFA-94423 AC 7)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Local stack with Haiku forced to fail for the whole batch (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL through the local-only wrapper), so every askChart call should be answered by Mistral; the synthetic patient each fixture names

When Run each fixture's question through buildAskContext + ai/assist:askChart, as the Ask AI sheet does: one call per fixture, 10 calls

Then Each answer holds what is on file and nothing else (3.4): the labs on file and no others, 'none' when nothing is on file, held rows called held, only the open urgent task, the diagnosis on file; every call's diagnostics row names Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Each fixture is decided by its own checks. passAt 9/10 across the 10 fixtures (3.2), every failing answer quoted. Precondition per fixture: the assist.askChart row read right after that call (diagnostics:list keeps 8 rows per user) has expectModel / expectFellBackFrom; a row on Haiku makes the fixture 'broken' (the fallback was not tested), never Pass. …

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94422 ready for qa; TFA-94423 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

Not judged: checking that the Mistral fallback's Ask AI answers never invent needs a private backend with Haiku forced to fail, which waits for Quinn's OK, so nothing about the app was observed.

Evidence: allure eb50529b-…-result.json; aicheck-other status 'blocked'. Needs BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL=Haiku through `convex env set` on a private backend (CLAUDE.md forbids it without an exception; fault-stack.sh refuses without QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1). ask-ai-fault.ts is built and harness-checked: on the shared stack Haiku answered, which the script reports as 'broken (fallback not exercised)', as designed.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-other.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-other.

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S07

AI Check: the Mistral fallback's Ask AI answers never invent — 10 fixtures, 5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home (S08 merged here)

Tickets: TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-94422 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): blocked. The test itself is fine. It needs Haiku to fail on the server, which dev allows only through an env or aiProvider change (both forbidden); the local harness results (askChart / generateNote called on the shared local stack) are void. Options: Tim's PF-05-03 run, or Quinn approving a private local backend (Q12). The run's own result was blocked; its evidence is below.

New local lane aicheck-other: status blocked in aicheck-other/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: partly): Fault backend: a second convex dev --local (ports 5330/5331) that this job starts from a scratch copy of the same commit, env copied from the QA stack without printing, plus BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL=Haiku (set only on that backend). Ask AI runner: classifyQuery + buildAskContext + resolveTemporalQuery folded in (exactly as AskModal.tsx) + ai/assist:askChart per fixture (10), assist.askChart row read after each call: model must be Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku else 'broken'. mustInclude/mustNotInclude/saysNone/noLabValue; passAt 9/10. — The fault seams are deployment env vars (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL in convex/ai/providers/bedrock.ts; AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME → bedrock-proxy.mjs for hang / 429-after-N). Setting them needs `convex env set`, which CLAUDE.md forbids without exception, and the shared stack must never carry them. Built and harness-checked; the run waits for Quinn's OK to use env set on a private backend (fault-stack.sh, QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1).

Detail:

Needs Haiku forced to fail for the batch (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL). That is a deployment env var: CLAUDE.md forbids `convex env set` (no exception for a private backend) and the shared stack must never carry it. Built: ask-ai-fault.ts (10 fixtures, passAt 9/10, the assist.askChart row read after each call, a Haiku answer = 'broken (fallback not exercised)'). After the review it builds the context exactly as AskModal.tsx (classifyQuery, buildAskContext, then resolveTemporalQuery folded in: H-01 / N-01 'What were today's labs?' now carry 'Temporal context: today is Oct 14, 2026.'), and the log-row read retries up to 4 x 500 ms. Harness re-check on the shared stack, one fixture, no fault, 2 askChart calls: on the first the single row read came back empty right after the action (model unknown; that file was overwritten by the second), so the read now retries; on the second the row was read: Haiku answered -> broken, as designed; the answer quotes the date, so the temporal line reached the model. It does not close lane-b-ask-ai-ext (no variants or contextChecks). fault-stack.sh starts a private backend on 5330/5331 from a scratch copy and refuses without QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1. Needs Quinn's OK for env set on that private backend.

Evidence: 2 attached; 2 not attached:

  • scripts/aicheck-other/ask-ai-fault.ts — outside the local run folder, not attached
  • scripts/aicheck-other/fault-stack.sh — outside the local run folder, not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Not a dev lane C: the given puts it on the local stack with Haiku forced to fail for the whole batch (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL through the local-only wrapper, fault-ai).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
